        "The original send operation notifies on_send_start, creates a base64 MIME draft, maps OwnedMailbox values into Graph Recipient/EmailAddress objects, PATCHes both the DSN Boolean and Bcc vector, then POSTs send. Each awaited request propagates failure with ?. Ignoring the returned entity is not ignoring request failure. Reuse the published three-stage/partial-server-state lesson rather than repeat it.",

Those later contracts are separate from the original builder/setter API. No compensating draft cleanup or recipient-delivery result is established by this test.",
        "The original GraphMessage/Recipient classes are explicit mock structures, not Graph API types. PATCH appends Bcc entries and updates DSN only when parsedReq.isDeliveryReceiptRequested is truthy. It cannot clear a previously true DSN flag or replace Bcc with an empty list. The accepted mock retains those branches; the positive test does not assert reset or replacement.",
        "The new test starts EWS and Graph mocks, configures both outgoing servers and passwords, and registers one cleanup hook to stop/delete both servers and remove logins. It sends one Graph message with DSN true and one Bcc recipient, awaits PromiseMsgOutgoingListener, then directly checks DSN, count, name and address. It does not directly cover DSN false/reset, empty/multiple Bcc, cancellation, server errors or recipient delivery.",
        "Manual assertion review: all four newly added Assert.ok/Assert.equal calls have no message argument. Their actual APIs require a nonempty expected-behavior message under the current deliberate rule. A useful local repair would state, for example, 'The sent Graph message should request DSN.' No tests were edited. Missing should alone in other authors' messages is not treated as a defect.",
        "The original DoOperation handler awaits do_operation and calls the listener's success/failure path; SafeMsgOutgoingListener maps these to OnSendStop and NS_OK/error status. The promise helper resolves on NS_OK. The new await observes request-operation completion, not eventual external delivery.",
        "Original initialize now fetches the key before URL parsing/state/pref writes. The historical service sets server.key before returning a new server; historical key() can fall back to prefs. Fixed accepted service instead calls initialize(key,newServer), and key() reads only memory. Required missing-pref diagnostics and Arc receiver comments are scoped implementation changes, not a global Arc/Rc or logging policy.",
        "Comment review: the send_message summary still describes creation then send and omits the intervening PATCH; the implementation and test distinguish all three stages. The mock's positive-only DSN comment accurately states its limited behavior and must not be read as a general Graph reset guarantee. As a readability suggestion, separate mapping, message construction, request construction and awaited I/O; preserve local formatter choices and generated-code exceptions.",
        "Complete primary 2008857 current comments 0–4, activity and footer were read from its original A capture. The author adds DSN alongside Bcc because both use the same update request. Related 2008856/2025550 are separate dependency phases; no external API execution is inferred.",

The request to delete the Graph outgoing server during cleanup is adopted by the owned setup. Preserve this exact source/discussion mismatch rather than infer adoption from Done.",

On body-state lines, body-line count increments instead of appending header bytes; failed nonempty header append still returns a failure in header state, a distinct path.",

ParseAFolderLine discards ParseFolderLine's result and returns NS_OK; StoreIndexer explicitly keeps scanning while ignoring that public result. nsParseNewMailState::HandleLine instead returns the internal result after checking the DB. The state change stops later body bytes from being appended to the header vector after a header-boundary failure.
